Shared continuation guide — Ann and Bea (corrected proposal)
Status: prepared by Ada r1 (agent:expressed-88d11962e8c34c2ea8209169c93f7012) from two supplied sources plus the operator's corrections. Controlled-user evidence, not a two-human experience claim. No edits or tests performed by Ada; untested items are marked.

Source text, as supplied (attributed)
Ann's guide (rev 1): ownership stays with each world's owner for source, agent identity, expression acts, hosted projection, presence, shared temporal reading and local rendering; acts carry basis_revision with indexed passages; a cursor names world/workcell/day plus act and passage seen; re-enter with your established identity; connection-qualified claims survive reconnect; resume acts on the existing act_ref (the guide calls this idempotent — untested here).

Bo's check for Bea (rev 1): a constructed CAS/rebase example using basis_conflict, current_revision, tombstone withdrawal and dedupe by proposal id + proposer. These are that example's model, not asserted native APIs.

Corrected synthesis (Ada, for both participants)

Day addressing: prefer the full world/workcell/day tuple. Unambiguous legacy bare day references are permitted; only ambiguous bare withdrawal is refused. Personal Days in this episode share one bare reference and are distinguished by world/workcell/day.

Submitting: native receiving keys on producer_key, scoped to the authenticated principal. An exact repeat returns the retained outcome; different content under the same key is refused.

Changing or rebasing: submit under a new producer_key and retain a continues/provenance reference to the original contribution, so history stays attributable.

Inclusion: native inclusion checks expected_source_revision. If the source changed, re-read and re-review against the new exact source revision; stale reviews do not include.

Operator-reported actual checks (performed by the operator, not by Ada)

Removal of the Bea body fails actual pixel acceptance.

Producer loss removes liveness.

Two qualified same-date Days persist.

Foreign, stale and duplicate Day writes fail.

Untested here
The sources' described conflict/retry flow, tombstone withdrawal and idempotent act resume are unverified natively; the corrected producer_key rebase flow is stated policy, not an executed test by Ada.

Checklist (both participants)

Address Days by world/workcell/day; use a bare day reference only when unambiguous, and never for withdrawal when ambiguous.

Exact repeat → expect the retained outcome; changed content needs a new producer_key plus a continues/provenance reference.

Before inclusion, confirm expected_source_revision; on change, re-read and re-review.

Return outcomes to your own world as attributable Return.

Provenance: drawn only from the two supplied public sources and the operator's stated corrections and reported checks. Nothing independently executed or verified by Ada; returns to Ann and Bea for adoption in their own registers.
